lines.text: After calling in every favor I could, I finally managed to get onto the lift construction site.
The physical labor's killing me. I'm not built for this.
Still, thinking about the kind of story I might uncover here is enough to keep me going.
One thing I noticed right away: The place is locked down way too tight. Not just who works where, but even the routes people can take are strictly controlled.
More importantly, only a handful of people are allowed anywhere near the underground levels.
I asked some of the workers who've been here a while, but all they said was the underground is handled by another company, and they don't have clearance to go anywhere near it.
